title: abelmoschus hostilis
intro: Abelmoschus hostilis, commonly known as Indian Mallow, is a plant species in the mallow family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and aiding in wound healing, as well as its use in traditional medicine to manage fever and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Abelmoschus hostilis include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate immune response, exhibit antioxidant activity, and facilitate tissue repair.
